text.en: The sitio of Poscolon in the barrio of Calaigang, Municipality of Barotac Viejo, Province of Iloilo, is converted into a barrio of said municipality to be known as the barrio of Poscolon.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1957.
